snippet.title: DDS2 | Release Date Trailer for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
snippet.description:
DDS2 is coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on 17 June 2026! This indie sensation co-op game lets you become a shady businessman. Lead your crime empire from your couch.

Check it out here:
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/pl-pl/concept/10014022 
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/pl-PL/games/store/drug-dealer-simulator-2/9nkc4knt8938

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/jun4k3Hzh6 

DDS1 is already available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4
